label: before
note: Baseline from fix/streaming-frame-budget prior to async Worker pipeline. Frame budget streamer existed but chunk generation remained main-thread sync (getChunk / computeVertexNormals / Color flatMap).

frame.observation: Browser frame timing was not ring-buffered; Spike20/33 and generationLatencyMs were the primary signals.

streaming.bottleneck: Boundary crossing could request many chunks; each create paid generateChunk + BufferGeometry + computeVertexNormals + Color flatMap + collider on the main thread even with maxCreates=2.
